test_mirror_to_session: test the mirror_to_session function to mirror a message to a session by platform and chat_id
test_find_session_id: test the _find_session_id function to look up a session ID by platform and chat_id with optional thread_id
test_append_to_jsonl: test the _append_to_jsonl function to append a message record to a session JSONL transcript file
test_append_to_sqlite: test the _append_to_sqlite function to append a message to the SQLite session database and close the connection
test_session_id_disambiguation: test the _find_session_id function to disambiguate sessions with the same chat_id using thread_id
